name: Smart Pregnancy Calculator Suite
author: hayyatapps

sections.description:
Smart Pregnancy Calculator Suite is a complete, mobile-friendly pregnancy &
baby planning toolkit you can drop on any page with a shortcode. It’s designed
for clinics, blogs and health websites that want traffic, leads and a premium,
modern experience.

Built around a clean interface, a soft pink/rose design system with a single
calm icon style (no busy multi-colour combos and no purple/blue shades),
modern Plus Jakarta Sans typography, and full label/colour customization in
any language.

Calculators

  • Due date calculator — all inputs on one step, with a “calculate based on”
    selector: Last Menstrual Period, Conception Date, Known Due Date, Ultrasound
    Date or IVF Transfer Date
  • Clickable trimester tabs (1st / 2nd / 3rd) with an overview of each stage
  • “Development week by week” panel with previous/next buttons to step through
    baby size and weekly development for any week (1–40)
  • Milestone timeline & estimated conception / fertile window dates
  • Weekly pregnancy tips
  • Pregnancy weight gain estimator (Pro)
  • Ovulation / fertile window calculator (Pro)
  • Gender prediction fun tool with disclaimer (Pro)
  • Hospital bag checklist — saved on the visitor’s device (Pro)
  • Doctor appointment reminders (Pro)

Conversion features

  • CTA buttons: Email my results, Download PDF, Book appointment, Contact clinic, Share result
  • Shareable result links — saved in the database so the link reopens the exact
    results page for any visitor, on any device
  • Lead capture (name, email, phone) — optional or compulsory to view results (Pro)
  • Email results to the visitor and notify the admin (Pro)
  • Export leads to CSV (Pro)

Email delivery

  • Set the sender name and sender email for all outgoing emails
  • Custom email subject with tokens
  • Bring your own HTML email template — paste it or import a .html file; supports
    tokens such as {{name}}, {{results}}, {{due_date}}, {{title}}, {{logo}},
    {{book_button}}, {{disclaimer}}, {{site}} and {{year}}
  • Leave the template blank to use the built-in design

Admin

  • Modern, clean white admin UI
  • Change title, subtitle, button text and all labels (any language)
  • Change colours, font, layout and corner radius
  • Choose date format
  • Dedicated Email settings tab (sender + HTML template import)
  • Custom medical disclaimer + emergency notice
  • Clinic/brand logo and contact details

Must-have disclaimer

A visible note is shown under every result:
“This calculator provides estimated dates only and should not replace
professional medical advice.” (fully editable)

Short Code

[smart-pregnancy-calculator]

Licensing

Every install starts with a 7-day Pro trial. After that the plugin gracefully
switches to the Free plan (due date, timeline and tips keep working). Pro
features unlock with a license key purchased from our website and activated
under Pregnancy Suite → License.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ and activate it.
  2. Go to “Pregnancy Suite” → Settings to configure.
  3. Place [smart-pregnancy-calculator] on any page.
sections.changelog:
2.4

  • New: shareable result links backed by the database — the link reopens the
    exact results for that calculation, anywhere.
  • New: “Development week by week” panel now has previous/next buttons to browse
    baby size and weekly development for any week.

2.3

  • New: Email settings tab — sender name, sender email, subject and a custom
    HTML email template (paste or import a .html file, with token support).

2.2

  • Modern typography (Plus Jakarta Sans) loaded reliably across themes.
  • Constrained input field widths and guarded against theme text-casing.
  • Fixed the milestone navigation arrows (hidden when there’s nothing to scroll).

2.1

  • Front-end redesign: removed purple/blue shades and multi-colour icons in
    favour of a clean pink/rose look.
  • Due date calculator moved to a single step with a calculate-based-on selector
    (LMP, conception, due date, ultrasound, IVF transfer).
  • Clickable trimester tabs; tidied result spacing.
  • Admin: white background, refreshed brand logo, pink accents.

2.0

  • Complete rewrite: calculator suite, modern admin, lead generation, PDF/email
    results, clinic options, license/trial system and self-hosted storefront.

1.0

  • Initial due date / conception calculator.
